items.source:
Useful for proactive checks whether there are property values nested
further below the path for a constructor arg. If not then the
constructor arg can be considered missing and not to be instantiated.
items.translation: 适用于主动检查构造函数参数路径下是否存在更深层嵌套的属性值。如果不存在，则该构造函数参数可被视为缺失，无需实例化。

items.source: Strategy for constructor binding to look up the values to bind to a given constructor parameter.
items.translation: 用于查找要绑定到给定构造函数参数的值的构造函数绑定策略。

items.source: Resolve the value for the given name and target parameter type.
items.translation: 解析给定名称和目标参数类型的值。

items.source: name - the name to use for the lookup, possibly a nested path for constructor parameters on nested objects
items.translation: name - 用于查找的名称，可能是嵌套对象构造函数参数的嵌套路径

items.source: type - the target type, based on the constructor parameter type
items.translation: type - 基于构造函数参数类型的目标类型

items.source: the resolved value, possibly null if none found
items.translation: 解析后的值，如果未找到则可能为null。

items.source: Return the names of all property values.
items.translation: 返回所有属性值的名称。

items.source: Rod Johnson, Juergen Hoeller, Rob Harrop, Stephane Nicoll, Kazuki Shimizu, Sam Brannen
items.translation: Rod Johnson，Juergen Hoeller，Rob Harrop，Stephane Nicoll，Kazuki Shimizu，Sam Brannen
